name: Aoife O'Connell
title: Lead Graphic Designer
summary: Lead Graphic Designer with 10+ years of experience creating brand systems, digital campaigns, and marketing assets across agency and in-house environments. Known for translating business goals into polished visual storytelling, mentoring designers, and delivering consistent design quality across print, digital, and social channels.

bullets: Led a 6-person design team delivering brand and campaign work for 20+ clients across retail, tech, and hospitality.
Reduced average campaign turnaround time by 22% by improving briefing, review, and asset handoff workflows.
Directed the rebrand of a national consumer client, resulting in a 31% increase in digital engagement over 6 months.
Established layout and accessibility standards that improved consistency across print and social outputs.
Designed multi-channel marketing materials for events, product launches, and B2B campaigns with budgets up to €250k.
Collaborated with copywriters, marketers, and developers to deliver 40+ landing pages and campaign suites annually.
Created motion-led social assets that increased average click-through rates by 18% across paid campaigns.
Mentored junior designers and introduced a shared asset library that cut duplicate production work by 15%.
Produced brand collateral, pitch decks, brochures, and presentation materials for agency clients across Ireland and the UK.
Managed end-to-end print production for high-volume jobs, maintaining a 98% on-time delivery rate.
Helped refresh 12 client brand guides, improving visual consistency across internal and external communications.
Worked closely with account teams to refine concepts based on stakeholder feedback and performance data.
Supported senior creatives with layout, image editing, and artwork preparation for print and digital campaigns.
Prepared final artwork files for production and maintained accurate version control across active projects.
Built strong working knowledge of typography, colour management, and prepress standards.
Contributed to pitch presentations that helped secure three new retained clients.

education.institution: Dún Laoghaire Institute of Art, Design and Technology
